title: What to Know About Brazil’s Election as Bolsonaro Faces Off With Lula
summary_full: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, the leftist incumbent, and Flávio Bolsonaro, the right-wing challenger, face off in a narrow race that could redefine the future of Latin America.
